blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has declared special non-working days in Tawi-Tawi, the municipality of Lumban in Laguna, and 17 municipalities in Camarines Sur and Masbate for their respective anniversary and cultural celebrations. Under Proclamation No. 1445, Sept. 23, 2026, was declared a special non-working day in Tawi-Tawi to allow residents to participate in the province’s 53rd anniversary celebration on Sept. 27, which falls on a Sunday. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto signed the proclamation on Sept. 16 by authority of the president.
